title: Jeete raho auno
body:
ay mere pyaron raaj dularon
raazi hui maa khuld sidharo
<<DIVIDER>>
laashon pe ye bachon ki sada deti thi maadar
jeete raho aun o mohamed
<<DIVIDER>>
kya jang ladi pyaas mein zainab ke dularon
ustad ko aadaab karo ay mere pyaron
tareef bahot karte hai abbas e dilwar
jeete raho aun o mohamed...
<<DIVIDER>>
maa karz utaare to bhala kaise utaare
khul kar ye bataate hai hamein zakhm tumhare
tum ne mere bhai ke liye khaaye hai pathar
jeete raho aun o mohamed...
<<DIVIDER>>
maadar na kahegi ke koi kaam karo tum
jaage huwe raaton ke ho aaram karo tum
ab tumko jagayegi na mazloom ki khwahar
jeete raho aun o mohamed...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay dilbaran e jaffar tayyar
alwida alwida alwida alwida
<<DIVIDER>>
shimr o umar ke sar jo utaaro to khush hoo mai
dushman ko jhoom jhoom ke maaro to khush hoo mai
<<DIVIDER>>
ay dilbaran e jaffar tayyar
alwida alwida alwida alwida
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai ki taraf dekh ke dam bhai ne toda
qabza na magar haath se shamsheer ka choda
kya khoob hai andaaz mai qurban hoo tum par
jeete raho aun o mohamed...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab dil mein ye khwahish hai jo ghar laut ke jaaun
pani mai sada naam pe dono ke pilaaun
pyase jo palat aaye ho tum nehr pe jaa kar
jeete raho aun o mohamed...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay dilbaran e jaffar tayyar
alwida alwida alwida alwida
<<DIVIDER>>
bachon zaeef mamu ko zehmat na dijiyo
laashe uthaye bhai to jumbish na kijiyo
<<DIVIDER>>
ay dilbaran e jaffar tayyar
alwida alwida alwida alwida
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon behta raha moo se shikayat nahi nikli
baazu pe chali taygh jigar par lagi barchi
ro ro ke dua dete hai khud hamza o jafar
jeete raho aun o mohamed...
<<DIVIDER>>
mamta ne takallum rakha jazbaat pe qaabu
bhai ke liye rakh liye bibi ne sab aansu
sar choom ke bachon ke ye kehti rahi muztar
jeete raho aun o mohamed...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay dilbaran e jaffar tayyar
alwida alwida alwida alwida
author: Mir Takallum
